name: Threat Hunting - Proofpoint clicked and then user had a login shortly after - Okta possible compromised account
xql_query:
dataset = proofpoint_tap_raw
| filter _log_type = "click-permitted"
| fields clickIP, senderIP, recipient, url, GUID, _time as pp_time
| join (
    datamodel dataset = okta_sso_raw
    | filter xdm.event.outcome = "SUCCESS"
    | filter xdm.source.ipv4 != null
    | fields xdm.source.ipv4 as loginIP,
             xdm.source.user.upn as loginUser,
             xdm.source.user.username as loginDisplayName,
             xdm.source.location.country as loginCountry,
             xdm.alert.risks as riskFlags,
             _time as okta_time) as okta
  senderIP = okta.loginIP
| filter okta_time >= pp_time
| fields recipient, senderIP, url, GUID, pp_time,
         loginUser, loginDisplayName, loginCountry, riskFlags, okta_time
alert_name: Threat Hunting - Proofpoint clicked and then user had a login shortly after - possible compromised account
